value.name: Rosa watches the child and dog play
value.description: Rosa pauses to watch a child throw a ball badly and a dog catch it anyway.
evidence: the child threw the ball badly and the dog caught it anyway

value.name: Rosa nearly cries in public
value.description: Watching the scene moves Rosa to the verge of tears, which is unusual for her in public.
evidence: Rosa was surprised to find that she was, herself, almost crying
which was a thing she did not, as a rule, allow herself to do in public

value.name: Rosa goes home and makes dinner
value.description: Rosa returns home and prepares dinner for herself.
evidence: She went home. She made dinner.

value.name: Rosa eats at the table again
value.description: Rosa eats dinner sitting at the table, something she has not done in years.
evidence: She ate it sitting at the table, which she had not done in some years.

value.name: Lucia visits her brother in Fitler Square
value.description: On Sunday, Lucia takes the train to her brother's apartment in Fitler Square, a place she has rarely visited in years.
evidence: On Sunday Lucia took the train to her brother's apartment in Fitler Square
which she had been to only twice in eight years

value.name: Lucia and Daniel spend the afternoon together
value.description: Lucia and her brother Daniel spend the afternoon together, though their conversation is withheld from Asha and the reader.
evidence: What they said to each other Asha would not know and did not need to know

value.name: Lucia and Daniel return separately
value.description: They come back to the house on Spruce Street separately, with Daniel leaving in the evening and Lucia returning alone.
evidence: They came back to the house on Spruce Street separately
Daniel returning to his own apartment in the evening and Lucia returning to the house alone

value.name: Lucia watches the street and decides things
value.description: That night Lucia sits in the sewing room watching the street and reaches decisions she had previously been unable to make.
evidence: Lucia sat that night in the sewing room
watched the street the way her mother had used to watch the street
and decided, in the watching, several things she had not been able to decide before
value.location_hint: sewing room, house on Spruce Street

value.name: Appraiser Pelletier arrives
value.description: On Monday morning, an experienced appraiser named Pelletier comes to evaluate the house.
evidence: On Monday morning the appraiser came
He was a man in his sixties named Pelletier who had appraised houses in this neighborhood for thirty years

value.name: Pelletier appraises the house for hours
value.description: Pelletier spends three hours measuring, photographing, and inspecting the house from basement to roof.
evidence: He spent three hours in the house
He measured the rooms and photographed the moldings and tapped the plaster and went down into the basement with Lucia and up onto the roof

value.name: Pelletier returns from the roof disheveled
value.description: Pelletier comes back down from the roof with his hair slightly disordered, implying the inspection has continued to the top of the house.
evidence: came down again with his hair slightly disor
